I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm that Caspian Halvorsen is now their go-to escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Nettle rollout.

I didn't save it again myself. gbrain already saves every DM as a fact that only Hollis can see. Writing it again with the `remember` tool could have made it a fact other members can see, because the call has no setting to keep it private. I took no other action, since Hollis said none was needed.
